answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 32927 Country: India Title: Our father died leaving behind four sons and two daughters. Question: Our father died leaving behind four sons and two daughters. He left us with no will. The property is to be divided among us. Do the daughters too have a share in the agricultural and commercial lands? Is there a law restricting the daughters to share only in certain properties? Answer ID: 32927 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1097/923/B=1432) There is no such Islamic ruling that the girls shall get their shares in particular property. The girls shall get their shares in all kinds of property like boys. Hence whatever property your father left behind, after paying due rights preceding inheritance, shall be divided into 10 shares; each son shall get 2-2 shares and each daughter 1-1 share. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
